card.law_is_about: Repealing the FernUSG approval regime and changing distance-learning funding rules.
card.they_claim: Official approval fees for one course are in the middle-to-high four-digit range.
card.the_problem: Official fees depend on course price and start at1050EUR for ordinary approval, with lower rates for some cases. The author may be describing typical courses rather than a universal minimum; that empirical reading is untested.

locator.section: Article1, Begründung, paragraph on single-course ZFU approval fees

request_quote.original: Wir begrüßen die Abschaffung des FernUSG ausdrücklich sehr.
request_quote.translation_en: Translation: We expressly and strongly welcome abolition of the FernUSG.

correction: The original ZFU schedule dated16August2023 sets ordinary first approval at150%of the course sale price, minimum1050EUR; approval following provisional approval uses200%with the same minimum. The fee is not universally middle/high four digits. A September2,2026BayernPortal administrative description corroborates the ordinary minimum and mentions reductions for course prices below250EUR. Middle/high four-digit fees can nevertheless arise for sufficiently expensive courses.
effect: Unresolved. A universal fee-band reading overstates lower-cost course fees, which could amplify the cost argument for repeal. A description of the usual fee on the courses the association has in mind is not refuted merely by a lower statutory minimum.
limits: No actual BDÜ fee assessment or representative course-price dataset has been obtained. Does not prove that1050EUR is affordable for short webinars, that all webinars need approval, or that repeal is unwise. Separate documentation effort is explicitly additional in the author text and must not be conflated with the official fee.
context_and_alternatives: All three author pages read from OCR and cleaner register text; original physical2 visually checked. The paragraph immediately mentions90-minute webinars, making lower-price examples relevant, but does not explicitly claim a legal minimum or quote the tariff. Strongest rescue is an experiential typical-fee range. Fee schedule is a pre-author original; exact addressed August draft remains unavailable.
materiality_explanation: Potentially minor numerical range issue: lower fees weaken the scale of the burden illustration, but meaningful fixed cost and documentation effort remain. A major change to the repeal argument is not established.
